findings.summary: The official dc-menu.html page is a menu shell with no item text. Luna's 23-product official dinner enumeration and 13-product official beverage enumeration cannot be verified from the asserted restaurant-issued source.

Frozen allergen claims labeled official ingredients are not supported by a restaurant-issued allergen document. Available positive ingredient and celiac/cross-contact wording is Toast linked-vendor content and must retain that authority; negatives and complete arrays are unsupported.

The current canonical Toast DC dinner/takeout surface and six current products were missed, while two scout dinner products are absent from the reviewed current Toast catalog. This is catalog drift/extraction scope failure.

Toast explicitly says fry-oil cross contamination for Garlic Chives Gao, Breakfast Fried Rice, Canto Egg + Shrimp, and Canto Egg + Ham. This supports a narrow linked-vendor cross-contact warning only, not generalized may-contain arrays or celiac/gluten negatives.

verifier.summary: Independent verification found material source-authority and catalog-extraction discrepancies. The official DC menu URL cannot substantiate Luna's official dinner/beverage inventory. Current product detail is available through linked Toast surfaces only; allergen evidence is partial positive-only or unavailable, and explicit Toast fry-oil language must not be converted into broad allergen arrays. All 21 frozen items were reconciled once; Surfside Iced Tea is missing from reviewed current DC sources.
coordinatorNotes: Read-only verification only; no ledger, generated data, or result file was modified.
